# Business Plan Development

## When to use
Use when the task requires draft practical 30/60/90-day launch plans for verified opportunities requiring user consent for external actions.

## Procedure
Define value proposition, buyer, sample offer, repeatable delivery, costs, tools, legal/payout constraints, pricing, marketing routes, success gates, 30/60/90 milestones. Minimize upfront costs; request explicit user permission before account signup, purchases or customer contact.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
